snippet.title: 【Trailer】The King of Fighters '97 OL mobile game
snippet.description: 【Trailer】The King of Fighters '97 OL mobile game. Perfect World and its subsidiary Ledo Interactive today announce a new online FTG mobile game based on KOF97 licensed from SNK Playmore. The first test phase in China is scheduled to begin within this month.
